```plato
//==
// # Collision
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Colliders
//  - Contacts, collision events, and queries
//  - Contact constraint rows

//==
// # Colliders
//
// Collider shapes attached to bodies, and the broad-phase filtering that says
// which of them may interact. Layer references are zero-based indices into an
// external layer array. Positions are in meters.

//==
// # Filtering

// Broad-phase filter bits for a collider. CategoryBits says what the collider
// is; MaskBits says what it collides with (two colliders interact when each
// one's category intersects the other's mask). GroupIndex overrides the bits:
// a shared positive group always collides, a shared negative group never
// collides, 0 defers to the bits.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Collision_detection)
type CollisionFilter
    implements IValue
{
    CategoryBits: Integer;
    MaskBits: Integer;
    GroupIndex: Integer;
}

// A symmetric layer-versus-layer collision table. Enabled is row-major with
// LayerCount * LayerCount entries; entry (row * LayerCount + column) says
// whether layers row and column may collide.
type CollisionLayerMatrix
    implements IValue
{
    LayerCount: Integer;
    Enabled: Array<Boolean>;
}

//==
// # 3D colliders

// A spherical collider: a sphere placed by a pose in the owning body's local
// frame.
type SphereCollider
    implements IValue
{
    Shape: Sphere;
    LocalPose: Pose3D;
}

// A box collider: a box placed by a pose in the owning body's local frame.
type BoxCollider
    implements IValue
{
    Shape: Box3D;
    LocalPose: Pose3D;
}

// A capsule collider: a capsule placed by a pose in the owning body's local
// frame.
type CapsuleCollider
    implements IValue
{
    Shape: Capsule3D;
    LocalPose: Pose3D;
}

// A triangle-mesh collider placed by a pose in the owning body's local frame.
// When Convex is true the mesh is treated as (or decomposed to) a convex
// hull, allowing dynamic-versus-dynamic collision.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Convex_hull)
type MeshCollider
    implements IValue
{
    Mesh: TriangleMesh3D;
    Convex: Boolean;
    LocalPose: Pose3D;
}

// A rigid group of 3D colliders sharing one owning body, stored per shape
// kind. Any of the arrays may be empty.
type CompoundCollider3D
    implements IValue
{
    Spheres: Array<SphereCollider>;
    Boxes: Array<BoxCollider>;
    Capsules: Array<CapsuleCollider>;
    Meshes: Array<MeshCollider>;
}

//==
// # 2D colliders

// A circular collider: a circle placed by a pose in the owning body's local
// frame.
type CircleCollider2D
    implements IValue
{
    Shape: Circle;
    LocalPose: Pose2D;
}

// A rectangular collider: an oriented box placed by a pose in the owning
// body's local frame.
type BoxCollider2D
    implements IValue
{
    Shape: OrientedBox2D;
    LocalPose: Pose2D;
}

// A planar capsule collider: a 2D capsule placed by a pose in the owning
// body's local frame.
type CapsuleCollider2D
    implements IValue
{
    Shape: Capsule2D;
    LocalPose: Pose2D;
}

// A rigid group of 2D colliders sharing one owning body, stored per shape
// kind. Any of the arrays may be empty.
type CompoundCollider2D
    implements IValue
{
    Circles: Array<CircleCollider2D>;
    Boxes: Array<BoxCollider2D>;
    Capsules: Array<CapsuleCollider2D>;
}

// A non-solid 3D volume that reports overlap events instead of producing
// contact forces. Pose places the collider group in world space.
type TriggerVolume3D
    implements IValue
{
    Colliders: CompoundCollider3D;
    Pose: Pose3D;
    Filter: CollisionFilter;
}
```
